styles.name: phoenix-rising
styles.description: A crested firebird beats its raised wings and climbs from the embers, trailing a flickering flame tail

styles.name: dragon-flight
styles.description: A horned, bat-winged dragon flaps across breathing a flickering cone of fire over scorched ground

styles.name: hydra-heads
styles.description: A serpent body sprouts a new swaying neck with progress, up to nine snapping dragon heads

styles.name: kraken-depths
styles.description: A goggle-eyed kraken surfaces and swims toward a ship, tentacles writhing below the rolling waterline

styles.name: pegasus-gallop
styles.description: A white winged horse gallops across the sky, legs and feathered wings beating, over a stardust trail

styles.name: medusa-gaze
styles.description: Snake-haired Medusa stares down a line of warriors; her lengthening gaze turns each one to grey stone

styles.name: minotaur-labyrinth
styles.description: Ariadne's red thread winds through a walled labyrinth toward the horned Minotaur in its inner chamber

styles.name: icarus-sun
styles.description: Winged Icarus climbs from the waves toward a blazing sun, shedding more melted feathers the closer he flies

styles.name: cerberus-watch
styles.description: Three-headed Cerberus pads along on its chain, each pointy-eared head bobbing and snapping as it keeps watch

styles.name: valkyrie-ride
styles.description: A winged-helmed valkyrie gallops across the sky on her steed, spear levelled, trailing streaming speed lines

styles.name: yggdrasil-grows
styles.description: The world tree grows from sapling to vast ash: trunk rises, branches fork, a rustling crown widens, roots spread

styles.name: ouroboros
styles.description: A scaled serpent coils around a rotating ring, its open jaws closing on its own tail at 100%

styles.name: trojan-horse
styles.description: The wooden horse rolls on turning wheels toward the towered walls and arched gate of Troy

styles.name: mjolnir-strike
styles.description: Thor's hammer slams down at the edge of a growing rune-stone road, throwing jagged lightning on impact
